name: Seito Kaichou Hikaru ~Inma ni Senryou Sareta Gakuen~
original_name: 聖徒会長ヒカル～淫魔に占領された学園～
source:
There is a school where students learn how to hunt monsters. Yuki, Seira and Hikaru finally defeat Varmus, a monster. But their battle doesn't end yet.... A new enemy revives Varmus and Kotone, their teacher, is kidnapped by him. Following it, heroines are kidnapped one by one. His purpose is actually to make them give birth to monster babies....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090629203317/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012681]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
有一所學校，學生們在那裡學習如何狩獵怪物。由希、聖羅和光最終擊敗了怪物瓦姆斯。但她們的戰鬥還沒有結束……一個新的敵人復活了瓦姆斯，而她們的老師琴音被他綁架了。隨之而來的是女主角們一一被綁架。他的目的其實是讓她們生下怪物寶寶……
